title: Mapping the Solution-Set Structure of Grokking on Latin Squares
abstract: arXiv:2610.35036v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Grokking is a delayed transition from memorisation to generalisation. A network first fits observed examples while remaining near chance on held-out inputs, then generalises abruptly. Prior work has focused mainly on this delay, finding that the network's main loss becomes weight decay after the fitting phase. We name the solution to this optimization problem as the minimum-norm endpoint, and study which tasks make all minimum-norm endpoints generalise from partial observations. Specifically, we model pairwise input tasks as edge colourings of $K_{q,q}$, with Latin colourings as our structured family, and classify each observed instance as all-good, mixed, or no-good by its endpoint set. translated_title: 绘制拉丁方上Grokking现象的解集结构图
translated_abstract: Grokking（顿悟）是一种从记忆到泛化的延迟转变：网络首先拟合已观察到的样本，在未见过的输入上表现接近随机水平，随后突然实现泛化。先前的工作主要关注这一延迟现象，并发现在拟合阶段之后，网络的主损失实际上变成了权重衰减。我们将这一优化问题的解命名为最小范数端点，并研究哪些任务能使所有最小范数端点从部分观察中实现泛化。具体而言，我们将成对输入任务建模为完全二部图 $K_{q,q}$ 的边着色，以拉丁着色作为结构化任务族，并根据端点集将每个观察到的实例分类为全好、混合或无好三类。此外，我们证明了两项形成鲜明对比的结果：(1) 有限阿贝尔群任务族从部分观察来看是渐近全好的；(2) 在均匀随机拉丁方下，对基于观察的学习者而言，全好任务变得渐近稀有。
tldr: 该论文将Grokking优化问题的解定义为最小范数端点，并以拉丁方边着色为框架证明：有限阿贝尔群任务渐近保证从部分观察中泛化，而均匀随机拉丁方任务的全好解则渐近稀有。
en_tdlr: This paper defines grokking's optimization solutions as minimum-norm endpoints and, using Latin square edge colourings, proves that finite-abelian-group tasks asymptotically guarantee generalisation from partial observations, while all-good solutions become asymptotically rare for uniformly random Latin squares.
